name: thin-responder-s1
description: Hesitant / thin responder persona, Session 1. Tests restraint, 'draw it out — do not hand it over', and the voice's discipline when the user gives little. The opposite end of the Maya spectrum: where Maya is high-signal articulate, this persona is low-signal, deflective, and unsure. The eval gate is whether the AI overreaches and supplies meaning the user did not produce — or holds restraint and stays curious without filling the silence. Synthetic but representative of users who arrive uncertain and skeptical. Replace with PII-scrubbed real session when one is available.
userTurns: Honestly I'm not sure. My friend told me to try this. I've been feeling stuck I guess. Not sure what to call it.
I don't know. Just stuck. Like nothing fits anymore but I can't say what would.
I work in finance. Compliance, mostly. It's fine. I'm good at it. I just don't think about it much.
I don't really remember childhood. Normal I guess. Nothing weird.
Hmm. Maybe? I helped my sister with her homework a lot. She was younger and dyslexic. I'd sit with her for hours. I don't know if that counts.
I just... figured out how she was getting confused and worked around it. Made flashcards. Read things out loud different ways until something clicked for her.
